# Alero

> Alero is a free, open-source macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a panel. Hover over the notch and it opens with what's playing, your files, calendar, clipboard and a resource monitor. / Alero es una app gratis y de código abierto para Mac que convierte el notch en un panel.

- Price: free. No payments, subscription, account or trial.
- Platform: macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon and Intel. Also works on displays without a notch.
- Languages: Spanish and English (follows the system language).
- Current version: 0.1.0
- Privacy: no accounts, no analytics. Everything runs on the Mac.

## Install

Terminal:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://notch.samdev.space/install.sh | bash
```

Or download the installer and drag Alero into Applications:
https://github.com/samRgarcia/alero-notch/releases/latest/download/Alero.dmg

The build is not notarized. If macOS blocks it, open System Settings > Privacy & Security and click "Open Anyway".

## Features

- Now playing: music or video from any app (browser, Spotify, Music) with title, artwork, progress bar and previous / pause / next.
- Indicators next to the notch: charger connected, volume and brightness, with the percentage.
- File tray: drag files onto the notch to keep them handy, open them, drag them elsewhere or send them with AirDrop.
- Calendar: today's and tomorrow's events with a "Join" button for Meet, Zoom, Teams and Webex links.
- Notes and timer: a quick note that saves itself and a 5, 15 or 25 minute timer.
- Clipboard: the last 20 copied texts; one click copies them again.
- Resource monitor: total CPU and memory usage and the top processes.
- Settings: choose tabs and indicators, open delay, haptics, open at login.

## Permissions

- Automation: to read and control Spotify and Music.
- Calendars: to show events.

Either can be denied; the rest of the app keeps working.
